teaser.en: Called the wild mango, it is actually a bean-family tree whose yellow fruit is eaten raw or cooked.
teaser.sw: Kwa Kiingereza huitwa embe la porini, lakini kwa kweli ni mti wa jamii ya kunde ambao tunda lake la njano huliwa bichi au likipikwa.
teaser.dg: Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *wild mango*, ela kpweli ni muhi wa jamii ya kunde, na matundage ga rangi ya mandano nkuriwa maitsi au gachijitwa.

summary.en: *Mnyungwinyungwi*, the wild mango, is a big spreading tree of hot riverine and swamp forest with tasty yellow fruits. Its wood is carved into stools, mortars and drums.
summary.sw: *Mnyungwinyungwi*, au *mroma*, ni mti mkubwa uliotanda wa misitu ya kando ya mito na ya vinamasi katika maeneo ya joto, wenye matunda ya njano yenye ladha nzuri. Mbao zake huchongwa kuwa vigoda, vinu na ngoma.
summary.dg: *Mnyungwinyungwi* (kpwa Chingereza *wild mango*) ni muhi mkulu unaoenea, wa matsaka ga kanda-kanda ya miho na ga phatu pha madzi-madzi, phatu penye dzoho, wenye matunda ga mtswano ga rangi ya mandano. Nyama za muhi nkutsongwa kuhenda vihi, vinu na ngoma.

about.en:
*Mnyungwinyungwi* is a large, spreading deciduous tree. Its leaves are made of many small leaflets dotted with tiny translucent spots, which show when a leaflet is held up to the light. The flowers have no showy petals; instead, bursts of yellow-orange stamens make the colour.

The fruit is yellow and fleshy. Despite the English name, the tree is not a mango but a member of the bean family.
about.sw:
*Mnyungwinyungwi* ni mti mkubwa, uliotanda, unaopukutisha majani. Majani yake yana vijani vingi vidogo vyenye vitone vidogo vinavyopitisha mwanga, vinavyoonekana unapokishikilia kijani hicho dhidi ya mwanga. Maua hayana petali za kuvutia; badala yake, vishada vya stameni za rangi ya njano-machungwa ndivyo vinavyotoa rangi.

Tunda lake ni la njano na lenye nyama. Licha ya jina lake la Kiingereza, mti huu si mwembe bali ni wa jamii ya kunde.
about.dg:
*Mnyungwinyungwi* ni muhi mkulu unaoenea, ambao makodzage nkugbwa chila mwaka. Makodzage ganahendwa ni makodza madide manji genye mabara madide sana ambago mwanga unatsupa; ganaonekana uchiunula kodza dide na kurilola kpwa mwanga wa dzuwa. Maruwa tagana *petals* zinazoonekana sana; badalaye, mafungu ga nyuzi za rangi ya mandano na chungbwa (*stamens*) ndigo ganagopha rangi.

Tunda ni ra rangi ya mandano na rina nyama. Hata dzina ra Chingereza richigomba *mango*, muhi uhu si mwembe, ela ni wa jamii ya kunde.

where.en: It grows in riverine and swamp forest in the hot lowlands.
where.sw: Huota katika misitu ya kando ya mito na ya vinamasi katika nyanda za chini zenye joto.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye matsaka ga kanda-kanda ya miho na ga phatu pha madzi-madzi, kpwenye tsi za photsi zenye dzoho.

uses.en:
The fruit is tasty and is eaten raw or cooked.

The wood is used for stools, mortars and drums.
uses.sw:
Tunda lake lina ladha nzuri na huliwa bichi au likipikwa.

Mbao hutumika kutengeneza vigoda, vinu na ngoma.
uses.dg:
Matunda ni ga mtswano, na nkuriwa maitsi au gachijitwa.

Nyama za muhi nkuhumirwa kuhenda vihi, vinu na ngoma.

names.en: The ICRAF handbook gives the Digo name *mnyungwinyungwi*. In Swahili it is *mroma*, *mvoo* or *mtigonzi*. In English it is called the wild mango.
names.sw: Kitabu cha ICRAF kinatoa jina la Kidigo *mnyungwinyungwi*. Kwa Kiswahili unaitwa *mroma*, *mvoo* au *mtigonzi*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *wild mango*.
names.dg: Chitabu cha ICRAF chinapha dzina ra Chidigo *mnyungwinyungwi*. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mroma*, *mvoo* au *mtigonzi*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *wild mango*.

reason.en: The true mango it is named after
reason.sw: Mwembe halisi ambao umepewa jina kwa kuufuata
reason.dg: *Mwembe* wa kpweli, ambao ndio unaopha muhi uhu dzina ra Chingereza

reason.en: Another riverine tree of the bean family
reason.sw: Mti mwingine wa kando ya mito wa jamii ya kunde
reason.dg: Muhi wanjina wa jamii ya kunde wa kanda-kanda ya miho

reason.en: Fruit tree also carved into stools and mortars
reason.sw: Mti wa matunda ambao pia huchongwa kuwa vigoda na vinu
reason.dg: Muhi wa matunda ambao piya nkutsongwa kuhenda vihi na vinu
